steps.en: Officer opens the Complaint Code page in the staff portal
steps.id: Officer membuka halaman Complaint Code di portal staff
steps.why_en: The menu title exists but no page opens behind it.
steps.why_id: Judul menu ada tetapi tidak ada halaman di baliknya.

steps.en: Officer creates a new Complaint Code
steps.why_en: Only a text field on the offence rule screen; there is no Complaint Code list of its own.
steps.why_id: Hanya satu kolom teks di layar offence rule; tidak ada daftar Complaint Code tersendiri.

steps.en: Officer amends or deletes a Complaint Code
steps.id: Officer mengubah atau menghapus Complaint Code
steps.why_en: Amending works only through the offence rule; deleting is not possible.
steps.why_id: Mengubah hanya lewat offence rule; menghapus tidak bisa.

steps.en: Officer creates, amends, deletes about 40 charge description templates
steps.id: Officer membuat, mengubah, menghapus sekitar 40 template charge description
steps.why_en: No screen, storage or logic for charge description templates exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar, penyimpanan, atau logika untuk template charge description.

steps.en: Templates pull defendant name, ID and offence rule from OCMS data
steps.id: Template menarik nama defendant, ID, dan offence rule dari data OCMS
steps.why_en: Nothing fills template placeholders with notice or defendant data.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang mengisi placeholder template dengan data notice atau defendant.

steps.en: The correct charges are sent to State Courts for court application
steps.id: Charge yang benar dikirim ke State Courts untuk court application
steps.why_en: No charge generation or sending to State Courts exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pembuatan charge atau pengiriman ke State Courts.
